answer: A fresh identity starts at the Ocean desk with a 2,000-coin bond, which only shrinks once verified work earns it a signal badge on its thread of past jobs. A claim with no history is held a week while the desk checks every link; a fake loses the bond and is barred. One honest worker pays one bond and gets it back; 1,000 fakes would lock 2,000,000 coins just to file. One farm opened eighty new names; all eighty bonds were held and never came back.
